collection.description: A child claims earthworms improve the soil, while an elder insists they are pests.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child claims earthworms improve the soil, while an elder insists they are pests.

choices.label: Protect the worms and compare garden plots.
Remove worms from one test plot.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The protected plot thrives, though rainfall may also explain the difference.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The worms disturb seedlings, and the child revises the claim.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The comparison reveals unexpected differences between beds.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The plot suffers, and the elder admits the question is unsettled.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village gains more reliable evidence over time.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child grows impatient with results that refuse to be simple.
